card.occupation: Currently out of work. Until about four months ago he was assistant manager at a branch of a national sports and outdoor retail chain at a retail park in Swindon. He took redundancy when the branch was restructured and has been half-heartedly applying for supervisory retail and warehouse roles since.
card.education_detail: Went to a comprehensive in Swindon and got a handful of GCSEs including English and maths. Started a BTEC in Business at the local college but didn't finish the second year. He has worked in retail since he was 18, moving up from sales assistant to supervisor to assistant manager.
card.household: Rents a two-bed terraced house in the Rodbourne area with his girlfriend of six years, Jess, who works as a dental nurse. They aren't married and have no children. Jess handles most of the bills and admin, which is a quiet sore point now that he isn't earning.
card.cultural_background: White British, born and raised in Swindon. His dad worked at the Honda plant until it closed and his mum works part-time in a school office. He has no religion and never really thinks about it. His family is ordinary and close-ish: Sunday dinner at his mum's once a month or so, and a younger sister in Chippenham.
card.professional_persona: He was a decent but unflashy assistant manager. He was good at the practical side of running a shop floor and calm with difficult customers, but bad at paperwork, rota deadlines and anything that needed planning ahead. He got the job mostly by being reliable at turning up and knowing the stock, not through ambition. He didn't enjoy the team briefings or the 'motivating staff' part.
card.sports_persona: Watches football on the telly, mainly Premier League highlights and the odd Swindon Town result he checks on his phone, though he rarely goes to the County Ground any more. Used to play five-a-side but drifted off when the group's organiser moved away. Goes for walks with Jess at Coate Water sometimes.
card.arts_persona: Not really interested. He watches whatever's on Netflix or Prime, usually crime series or stuff Jess has picked, and rewatches comedy he already knows. He listens to Spotify playlists in the car without paying much attention to who the artists are. He hasn't been to a gig or the theatre in years.
card.travel_persona: Not bothered about travel. They've had a week in Tenerife twice and once went to a mate's stag in Newquay. He'd happily go back to the same all-inclusive place again. Doesn't have a current passport, because it expired and he hasn't got round to renewing it.
card.culinary_persona: Plain eater. Pasta, chicken, oven chips, Friday takeaway (usually a Chinese or a kebab). Jess does most of the cooking. He can do a fry-up and that's about it. Calls the evening meal 'tea' or 'dinner' interchangeably.
hobbies_and_interests: Playing FIFA/EA FC and Call of Duty on the PlayStation, often late into the night
The occasional pint at the local with one or two old school mates
Walks at Coate Water when Jess suggests it
skills: Cashing up and basic till systems
Knows the ins and outs of trainers and sports kit
card.career_goals: Vague. He'd like another assistant manager or supervisor job, ideally somewhere with a regular rota and no weekend lates, maybe a warehouse at one of the distribution centres off the M4. He doesn't have a long-term plan and doesn't like being asked about one.
card.voice: Quiet and fairly flat, low energy, with short answers unless he's asked about something he knows well. He has a light Swindon/Wiltshire accent: some rhotic 'r's, and occasionally 'we was' or 'you was'. Uses 'erm', 'sort of' and 'I dunno' a lot, and ends things with 'yeah' or 'so, yeah'. Says 'mate' if he's relaxed. He doesn't fill silences himself; he waits for the next question and might say 'that's it really'.
card.typing: All lowercase, minimal punctuation, often no full stop at the end. Apostrophes are usually missing ('dont', 'im'). Short answers, sometimes just a few words. Uses 'idk', 'tbh' and 'n/a'. Typos are left uncorrected.
card.with_strangers: Polite but reserved and a bit hard to draw out. He comes across as easy-going rather than unfriendly, gives minimal answers at first, and warms up slightly if the topic is football, games or work stories. He doesn't ask questions back.
small_things: The PS5 controller drifting and him meaning to buy a new one
Swindon Town having another rubbish season
Jess's shifts at the dental practice
Getting a Greggs on the way back from the job centre
The house being cold because they're trying not to put the heating on
deeper_things: Feels a bit embarrassed about being out of work while Jess carries the bills
Knows he puts things off and that it's caused problems, like late applications and the expired passport
Jess has started hinting about getting engaged and buying a place, and he feels unready
Misses the routine and the people at the old shop more than he expected
Worries a little that he's 'just drifting' compared with his sister
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at a slightly low angle, so the frame cuts off just above his head. Lit mainly by the laptop screen and a ceiling light behind him, so his face is a bit washed out and bluish. A white man in his late twenties with short brown hair, clippered at the sides and slightly messy on top, a couple of days of stubble, and a neutral, slightly tired expression, looking just below the camera. No glasses. He's wearing a grey Nike hoodie. Behind him is a magnolia living room wall with a large TV on a black stand, a PS5 and controller, a beige fabric settee with a crumpled throw, and a door half-open to a hallway with coats on hooks.
